# Add these lines to your project's .gitignore
# -----------------------------------------------

# Multi-agent coordination + memory: LOCAL, auto-generated state — never commit.
# WORKBOARD.md / PROGRESS.md are regenerated from the .json on every board write,
# so if they are tracked the working tree is perpetually dirty and every rebase
# is blocked until someone restores them by hand. Ignore the whole set.
WORKBOARD.md
WORKBOARD.md.lock
WORKBOARD.json
PROGRESS.md
PROGRESS.json
MEMORY.md

# IMPORTANT: .gitignore has NO effect on a file that is ALREADY tracked. If any
# of the above were committed before you added these lines, untrack them once
# (the files stay on disk; only git stops tracking them), then commit:
#     git rm --cached WORKBOARD.md WORKBOARD.md.lock WORKBOARD.json \
#                     PROGRESS.md PROGRESS.json MEMORY.md 2>/dev/null; true
#     git commit -m "chore: stop tracking auto-generated coordination state"
